mode.title: Scraping Mode
mode.description: Choose the scraping mode: product_only (items only), seller_only (sellers only), or product_with_seller (both)

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: URLs to start scraping from. For product modes, use item URLs (e.g., https://www.ebay.com/itm/...). For seller_only, use seller store/profile URLs (e.g., https://www.ebay.com/str/... or https://www.ebay.com/usr/...).

extractShippingOptions.title: Extract Shipping Options (US)
extractShippingOptions.description: When enabled, the scraper clicks the shipping widget and selects 'United States' to extract shipping cost & delivery estimates. Adds ~3 seconds per item. Disabled by default.
